Job Title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer

Required Skills:
- Python
- SQL
- Pandas and NumPy
- Scikit-learn
- Data preprocessing and model evaluation

Responsibilities:
- Prepare and analyze datasets.
- Build and evaluate basic machine learning models.
- Explain technical decisions and model limitations.
- Collaborate with team members on data-related tasks.

Preferred:
- Experience deploying machine learning models.
- Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms.
